title: Solo – a .so loader for static Linux binaries
summary: Solo is a .so loader specifically designed for static Linux binaries, enabling statically compiled programs to dynamically load shared libraries (.so files). It solves the limitation where static binaries traditionally cannot use dynamic linking features.
problem_solved: Enables static Linux binaries to load and use dynamic shared libraries (.so files) that they normally cannot access due to static compilation.
why_valuable: Provides flexibility for static binaries to leverage dynamic libraries without recompilation, useful for plugin systems, debugging, and runtime module loading in embedded or constrained environments.
